# attribution target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attributionTarget`](gmeow-attributionTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attributionTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The inscription being classified by a script/language attribution. Functional per relator: one target inscription per [`ScriptLanguageAttribution`](../classes/gmeow-ScriptLanguageAttribution.md).
